'''2010 Match Play Championship Day 1 Brian Hoffman LS Hoth''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Brian Hoffman]] at [[2010 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hoth (Light)|Hoth-L-hoth.gif|label=Hoth}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
